22F.2 If you walk in God's statutes and keep His commandments, and do them, He will give peace in the land, and none shall make you afraid.

precepts.text: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go. God leads through the prophets he sends, and many killed the prophets. That is why it says be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath. The brothers get guns pulled on them in the street just for reading the Bible. Are we the enemies because we tell the people the truth? No. Either repent, or die in your sins.
precepts.point: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed. Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day. Look at what David is asking for: lead me and teach me.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
“O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.” Then: “Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.” Look at what David is asking for: lead me and teach me.

Isaiah shows how God answers that: “Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.” He leads you by the way, in the direction you should go.

And God leads through the prophets he sends, and many of them were killed. People hate the word of God so much that they want to kill us. That's why it says be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath. The brothers go out to teach and get guns pulled on them, just for reading the Bible, while dudes drive by selling crack, fentanyl, whatever they sell. Guns pulled on us by Christian folk. That's why the church can't be stood: church is full of crap.

So are we the enemies because we tell the people the truth? No. You're just simple and you don't want correction. We are going to do our job and teach you the good and the right way, and keep our hands clean. What you do with it is on you. Either repent, or die in your sins.

precepts.text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called. So he's not calling all nations on the planet Earth. He's only calling Israel. He's not calling Catholics, Jehovah's Witnesses, Baptists. All that goes back to replacement theology, which came about through the Catholic church, then the Protestant church that many of us grew up in, that teach the same thing.
precepts.point: To be conformed to the image of his Son: he's going to transform us, the 12 tribes, into the image of his Son Christ, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

precepts.why:
“Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called”. Who did he call? “Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.” Jacob and Israel are his called.

So he is not calling all nations on the planet earth. He is only calling Israel. He is not calling Catholics, Jehovah's Witnesses, Baptists. The teaching that the called are everybody in the church all goes back to replacement theology, which came about through the Catholic church, and then the Protestant church that many of us grew up in, which teaches the same thing.

Put Amos, Isaiah 45 and Isaiah 48 together and Romans 8:29-30 opens up: the ones he foreknew, the ones he called, the ones he justified are the 12 tribes of Israel, predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son.

precepts.text: The portion of Jacob is not like them, for he is the former of all things, and Israel is the rod of his inheritance.
precepts.point: Where Moses was told to hide things he wrote the sons of God in Genesis instead of naming the tribes, which is why people think the tribes only came about later.

precepts.text: There is no peace, saith the Most High, unto the wicked.
precepts.point: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies, yet do I not decline from Thy testimonies. Thy word is true from the beginning, and every one of Thy righteous judgments endureth for ever. This word was here before anything, before the Book of the Dead, before the Koran, all that other garbage.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.” That is why “Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.” Salvation is very far from them because they have no rest in their wicked ways and no peace, and it does not matter whether it is the wicked among our people or the wicked among the nations.

David stands on the other side of that: “Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law. Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.” The one who does not forget the law can ask to be quickened; the wicked who seek not the statutes have no peace to look for.

precepts.text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel my called; only Israel was called.
precepts.point: The promise is unto you and to your children and to all that are afar off, meaning Israel and their seed, not all races and nations. The "afar off" are the scattered ones of verse 5, the Israelites dispersed to the four corners of the earth, as many as the Most High shall call.

note.label: Acts 2: Pentecost and the Scattered House of Israel

precepts.why:
Peter says the promise is to “as many as the Lord our God shall call”, and Isaiah shows who is called: “Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.”

Only Israel was called. So the promise unto you, to your children and to all that are afar off is to Israel and their seed, wherever they were scattered, as many of them as the Most High calls.

moments.label: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord

points: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness. For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.

I have declared the former things from the beginning — through prophecy — and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass. What is written came to pass. That is what we look at in the scriptures, because we are a prophetic ministry.

Because I knew that thou art obstinate. So God said, I knew you people. I know how you all are. You all are obstinate. And thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass; I have even from the beginning declared it to thee. Before it came to pass, he said, I had you write it down and I showed it to you.

Lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them. Because you all will give credit to another god. And my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them. Because you all do not believe in the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, you will give credit to another god. Just like people who come and listen to us, but they will not leave their ministry, and they will act like they already knew what we showed them.

Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them. You did not know the stuff that we were telling you. You all did not know nothing about no Israelites. You all knew nothing about no Passover. You know nothing about no Feast of Tabernacles coming up in October. You all did not know nothing about that. There were no black people getting in tents and going camping and sitting around a fire and talking about God. The Lord put a spirit on us. He showed us these secret things. And now look how our lives changed drastically. There were no black people piling into church on a Saturday with fringes, their women with skirts, saying shalom to each other. These were secret things that the Lord showed unto us.

They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them. Because that is how black people are. It makes me sick when they come and they say, I always knew I was an Israelite, I always knew Christ was black. Sit down. You did not know until you watched us bring it out. You saw us teaching. You saw us with the books. So that is what God is talking about here. That is how black people are. They will act like they already knew this instead of giving God the glory.

Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not. You never knew this until the Lord revealed his secret unto us. And now you see men with their beards. You see men with fringes on their shirts, and people looking at us weird. The Lord revealed it to us. Numbers 15:38 — put fringes and a border of blue on your shirt. Put your women in skirts. Have their head wraps. Throw out unclean food. Do not bother with no Christmas tree.

Yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb. For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off. Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

He has chosen us while we are getting beaten up. He is refining us. He said, I am going to defer my anger. The furnace of affliction is this captivity we are in. And he said, I still chose you. I still reveal my secrets unto you. I am still raising you up to be a great nation.

For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another. Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last. Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth. So we have got to give God the glory as we bring forth this story, as he is revealing these secrets to us.

And my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together. All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? Nobody ever told us what we know right now. These are the secrets of the Most High.

The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans. Because he is talking about America. He is going to do his pleasure on them. Why? He is revealing these things to us and he is making his name known to us, and he is bringing us our glory while we are in the furnace of affliction. He is talking about, I am going to destroy America.

I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous. Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me. Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel. That is who this Bible is for. That is who these secrets are for. To redeem the Israelites.
I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go. Because we were going in the wrong path. Now he is leading us in the way that we need to go.

O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! Which is what he told us from the beginning, when he brought us into a covenant. Then had thy peace been as a river. We would have been in peace right now. And thy righteousness as the waves of the sea: thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof. Our children that came forth from us. His name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth. Which is what we are doing with the secret that has been given to us. We are the Israelites in captivity. The Lord wants us to utter it to the ends of the earth. Say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction. In order for God to choose you, you have to go through the furnace of affliction. God is not choosing you if you have not gone through anything.

We have to prove to him that we are worthy, and in order to prove that, he puts us through things that hurt, even among each other in how we deal with each other. You pray for strength: he makes bad things happen to make you strong. You pray for faith: he makes you go through things to build your faith. You pray to learn to love your neighbour: he allows your neighbour to offend you, to see if you will apply that law. This is how the Lord proves who is real and who is not.
Come forth out of the waters of Judah says where we came from, and that tribe has always been around.
The city that comes down from God has twelve gates with the twelve tribes on them, which shows the tribes were there from the beginning.
Where Moses was told to hide things he wrote the sons of God in Genesis instead of naming the tribes, which is why people think the tribes only came about later.
